<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Legislative agenda:</strong> The Lok Sabha is set to introduce the Indian Statistical Institute Bill and the Bankers&#x27; Books Evidence Bill, while both houses review critical legislation including the Supreme Court Judges Bill and various MSME and exam-related amendments.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxNUnJZQ2V0RFctN056VkpBSnB6c3NqaDJQeXI3aXQzMEs3bDhTR01ZeW9oNFFkOW1lNHJrWWlyQ1U1MHhpMmx0X2ZjbjNoSDVreHBSd2RjV25jREJVYVptSklmNDNiWFVBSllDU1gxR1ZCNHo4RHEzRk8zMkNsc2VuOFFxa2hoeFVlVjFOal80WFBqRFZMX3FiUHNUZktmTEpGVUJjc3AzeUthQWhVMHgySFFlT01LVm9jNWVBVVJ4Q242c3FsSkJmRw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Parliamentary unrest:</strong> Opposition and BJP MPs have engaged in heated protests in Parliament regarding student issues and exam paper leaks, with the Opposition specifically targeting the government over alleged corruption and the handling of the Ram temple donation case.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxQM2g3UWNNX1Vfb1JHUGxRWFZGN2tfcEYyQTFNa3M2eDYzbFNiRE1tb0VCRUp0aVBmTVV2eTUxWld0UUUyYlREcXk3dFBoRDc2cVZnUGE2UkpfZzdscERJVGNWdzA5RVJoYUVzMC1iUFZtOTVaNTdleTk4Y0cyY2pra2JZQ0hFVVdDU2V4UWtlMGxxSUpUZWlUOHdTUGJGVkdhMHVkeVFPbw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I12</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxPNHhVdzExeEtKaVB2UVp0a194aU02UzFRNFN6X3lWZjU1bmhraF9rOGFVRTQtWXdUeDhvQ2NpQW44cktUMFFHQUtPQnpVVHlrT0IyTS1fdWJhUjQ4TnlCcVNDY1pTZmRicDc0M0NlVzBDSmNUc3lCaVN3UmoxYnZtZllEQlFIOGtqNGZON25YR1pzV0JvRHRrNTAtRzQyNnZhdk5UU0FIQVB2RWZoQW9Oc3lQZVRWUQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I18</a></span></li>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Judicial and investigative oversight:</strong> The Supreme Court is scheduled to hear multiple petitions concerning police brutality during recent protests and is being urged by the Congress party to oversee an SIT probe into the Ram temple donation theft case.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxPSGRZeWlHTTNlUGloVVkySkdQZXJXZEUybElzSkotWUVnUnNHTks4N3AxU043SmcxVnFqNEZCZDBLcFI3aTlzcUt0aVlLanV5WGNxakxweXFWaGZWb3huMlNCc21ZbHBNZERhM2o4MWdDOVNjRHhsdGtYeFhJcFpYQldMZDFfLVk5WEJ1OXlTV1NDTmxSM0NKMVU0amxBelVtem5jOG1qX1o?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Election and party strategy:</strong> As the Election Commission concludes its national conference, political parties are initiating early alliance talks for the 2027 assembly elections in states like Goa and Punjab.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxQU1U0Q3ZyTDBEQU9QZjhQTGFZOWpINFVkT2h3dG5ERWVCZUhUbEFzNmZpVC1CSlVHVW54TWNvXzdmX2VVNk95SmgwUlpEOUxsbnl1bmRTaG1lbU13U3ZzYVgyR0pYUkF2S0M3U2t5UlUybzBZV2RMMjZpRjBZaUJiRlQybEY1NXFEQTY0RWNPSGNneTV1dzlaNnVMZ0I5cy1BSmtud19xTnpkQQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W21</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Civil liberties concerns:</strong> The Congress party has criticized the Assam government’s use of the National Security Act (NSA) against land rights activist Pranab Doley, labeling the move an overreach and a misuse of extraordinary laws to silence dissent.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W11</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W12</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxOMGV3Ynh3QnhBcGY5Q0NjRXFZRGF3cHphZmlra2R6dDJKSFJnMElwZ2tYSWh1c0xLVUlJNnZqSm54dV9wNWFMbEx1MHF1NGdwU0V2YXN3RFQ3bDZpMFB1ZS1XTWQ5dm5BQy1aeTZfTUV0NHpuNVlqTTd3SlBQekQwcUFkNmhsVF85ZE5PZ1NFYUhUcDc0QS0zcUl3OFpkdw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W13</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W14</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W15</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W16</a></span></li>
